elements.element: No punitive/penalty-rate charge payable by Customer on late payment (300% multiplier)
elements.evidence: "extended payment charges shall be computed at the rate described in Subparagraph 7.8" (300% multiplier deleted)

elements.element: No forfeiture of assigned capacity value without payment or credit (penalty on default)
elements.evidence: "the defaulting Party shall be entitled to a pro-rata credit for the reclaimed capacity"

elements.element: No forfeiture of amounts already paid by Customer (penalty)
elements.evidence: "The defaulting Party is entitled to a pro-rata reimbursement of amounts it had paid ... for capacity not received."

elements.element: Cap on interest at highest lawful rate retained (no residual penalty above law)
elements.evidence: "extended payment charges shall be at the highest rate permitted by applicable law"

elements.element: Early-termination fee capped at 3 months' fees
elements.evidence: No early-termination fee provision appears in either 7.9 or 23.2 as rendered.

elements.element: Such fee is the sole liquidated amount payable by Customer
elements.evidence: No sole-remedy/liquidated-amount language is present in the rendered text.

offending_extra_words: shall be entitled to a pro-rata credit for the reclaimed capacity
is entitled to a pro-rata reimbursement of amounts it had paid under this Agreement for capacity not received
reasons: Preferred level is achieved: the 300% punitive multiplier is removed and the two default forfeitures (capacity without credit; non-refund of paid amounts) no longer impose a penalty on us.

Minimality fails: eliminating the penalty required only deleting or neutralising the forfeiture language, but the redline instead creates affirmative new entitlements to a 'pro-rata credit' and 'pro-rata reimbursement', granting rights beyond removal of the penalty.

The new 'pro-rata' mechanics are undefined (no calculation basis or timing), leaving a soft dangling mechanic, though the surrounding obligations (payment of accounts incurred pre-reclamation, Schedule revision) remain effective.
Fallback is independent and unmet (no early-termination fee capped at 3 months' fees as sole liquidated amount), but that is immaterial given the locked preferred target.
